offering_description.value: Provides payment acceptance and bill payment tools to lenders and other businesses through a platform that integrates with their existing software. It also offers managed vendor payments, programs for merchant service providers, and customer experience technology for utilities, insurers and government agencies.

quotes.quote: Payment technology evolves quickly; you need a partner that stays ahead of the curve. REPAY combines the best, established solutions with our extensive network of integrations enabling clients to quickly accept and make payments, all from a single platform.

Rick Watkin serves as President of KUBRA. In this role, he oversees KUBRA’s growth strategy and day-to-day operations across its utility, insurance, and government verticals. Rick has led KUBRA having joined the company as one of its earliest employees. Under his leadership, KUBRA has grown into one of North America’s leading customer experience management platforms, reaching more than 40% of U.S. and Canadian households.
